Service & Support In the event where the distance travelled exceeds the monthly usage variant, amount will be paid for additional Kms as per schedule. Similarly, the unused Kms in a particular month as against the minimum guaranteed usage variant will be carried forward to the next month and additional Km if any in the next month shall be adjusted against this. However, the payment for the selected usage variant in a month will be paid every month.” Further, the unused Kms in a particular month shall not be carried forward or adjusted beyond 6 months 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA SER GRC KOL A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Vehicle Required for the use of the Supervisors of BKSC under Dy.CEE/CON/HQ/GRC. 2. The entire work is for approximately 2500 KM per Months for 24 months. However, R ailway reserves right to close the contract earlier also without assigning any reasons a nd without liability on Railway Administration. 3. The work consists of supply of 01 nos Four wheelers road vehicles i.e, Mahindra Boler o Camper (Double Cabin), Tata Xenon (Double Cabin), Mahindra Imperio (Double Cabin) , Tata Xenon Yodha (Double Cabin) , Tata Xenon XT (Double Cabin) to relief in exigencies like brea kdowns, accidents, Stallings, derailments, inspection of higher officials etc, The vehicle to be offered should not be more than 02 years old from the date of 1st hand purchase of the vehicle which should be in good condition. 4. The vehicle shall be required to run on railway sites in difficult terrain and even in n on-motor able roads as per the requirement of Railway. 5. Contractor (s) shall be responsible for providing the vehicle at any time, even at shor t notice. The services shall be available for 24 hours in a day. No extra payment shall b e made for the movement of the vehicle if taken by the driver or for repair and any pur pose. 6. ln case the vehicle is stabled in the Shed/Garage/Portico or any other nominated pla ce as advised by the User, the vehicle shall remain under the custody of the driver only and Railway shall not bear the loss/damage to the vehicle during such period. 7. The vehicle, if required may go out of the nominated place and remain for days toge ther as per the requirement of the User (Railway Officer). During such period the vehicl e is required to be stabled at a place desired by the user, may be in open space. The ve hicle shall remain under the custody of the driver only; Railway shall not bear the resp onsibility of any damage or loss to the vehicle. In no case, the Railways shall provide a ny accommodation or allowance of any kind to the driver. 8. A name plate of suitable size is required to be made and fitted on the front of the ve hicle. The name plate should read "On Duty, Ministry of Railway, Govt. of India". 9. Vehicle colour should be white / white base colours. The vehicle should be mechanica lly sound and shall be well maintained with neat and clean interior/exteriors and hygie nic. Three pairs of seat-covers and towels to be changed on alternate days. 10. The driver must have the valid driving license, must possess good driving skill, obe dient and courteous. Driver should not be suffering from hyperhidrosis or any other me

dical conditions resulting in foul body odour. Medical Certificate to this effect should b e provided. The driver must be literate, having good knowledge of roads, navigation sk ills and familiarities with traffic rules and regulations and should be able to communica te properly. He should also be able to do the day-to-day maintenance of the vehicle's cl eanliness and functionality. Driver must have adequate control and patience and remai n calm and composed even in stressful traffic situations and should never be a part of r oad rage or reckless driving. 11. All other terms and conditions of the contract for Hiring of Vehicles, which are not s pecified; Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), will be governed by Service level Agr eement (SLA) for monthly basis cab & taxi hiring services of GeM Portal. 12. The vehicle should be available for any outstation duty during the Contract Period. The toll charges and other taxes for the outstation duty will be borne by the contractor . On production of toll receipt, the amount will be reimbursed by Railways. 13. In case of any break-down of the vehicle or in any other situation such as the firm f ails to provide the allocated category/model of vehicle, the firm must provide a higher category/model of vehicle as an alternative for stop-gap arrangement. 14. The tenderer shall submit their official address, Mobile / phone nos., e-mails, & Fax No. (if any) and the driver's mobile number for communication. 15. Driver should have a mobile phone with round the clock availability (24*7) to atten d movement/program details of the vehicle. Service provider should bear the charges r egarding Phone call/SMS communication with the user. 16. Driver should not use mobile phone during driving in emergency situation; he shoul d park the vehicle and talk/communicate with the permission of the occupant/passenge r. 17.The Railway in no case shall be responsible for any legal matters arising out of any State or Central Govt. laws/ rules in the matters of employing the driver by vehicle's ow ner/Contractor. 18.The contractor shall bear the cost of repair or renewal of any kind of Railway proper ties if damaged by driver's negligence in rough driving, carelessness. In regard to asse ssment of such loss on account of damages, the decision of the Officer for whom vehicl e is hired or his representative will be considered as final and binding on the Contracto rs. 19.Contractor shall be fully responsible for any repair, accident, loss and damages to t he vehicle and driver. If any fine or penalty is imposed by various authorities such as R oad Transport Officers/Authorities, Traffic police etc. for any violation such as speed, tr affic rules violation etc., the same will have to borne by the contractor only. 20.All hired vehicles should be equipped with prescribed emergency kit and a fire extin guisher as per statutory provision. 21. However, any penalty or fines etc. imposed by RTA, Police or other law enforcing a gencies due to failure/violation of traffic rules etc. are not payable to the contractor an d such risk and cost will be borne by the contractor. 22. Online/offline bill passing officer Dy.CEE/CON/GRC and bill paying officer PFA/CON/G RC. 23. After awarded the service contract, successful contractor and consignee made an Agreements for payments and any other terms and conditions etc. and also successful contractor should have to submitted all the documents of vehicle i.e. Vehicle registrati on Certificate, Insurance, Pollution Certificate etc. to office of the Consignee. 24. Firms should submit the following documents along with bid (a) Past Experience of same/similar. (b) Bidder Turnover, (c) ATC (d) Address of Service provider and Contract person with Mob/Toll free No. with proper documents. Failing which offers will be reject ed. The above said documents should attach at prenominated place on Bid document at tach other than pre-nominated place will not be evaluated and offer will be rejected. 25. Regarding Past Performance firm have to submit Satisfactory past performance Re port or Payment receipt from users. Only Contract copy is not proof of past performanc e.

26. Duration of the service contract may be extended up to 25% beyond the initial cont ract duration (subject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent). 27. Successful Bidder should submit the Performance Security in the form of Account P ayee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PFA/SER/GRC/KOL payable at PFA/SER/GRC/KOL. After award of contr act, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to e nsure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the executive department (Office of th e DEE/CON/KGP, KHARAGPUR West Bengal) within 30 days of award of contract otherwi se necessary penalty will be imposed as per extent rule. .
